def gety(p,q,m):
    w=p[:m*12].reshape(m,12)
    v=p[m*12:m*13]
    return np.tanh(q@w.T)@v+p[m*13]
def train(p,q,yt,m,schedule):
    log=[]
    for power,its in schedule:
        lam=.001
        last=1e20
        stagnant=0
        for t in range(its):
            w=p[:m*12].reshape(m,12)
            v=p[m*12:m*13]
            h=np.tanh(q@w.T)
            e=h@v+p[m*13]-yt
            scale=np.max(np.abs(e))
            loss=np.mean((np.abs(e)/scale)**power)
            weights=np.maximum((np.abs(e)/scale)**(power-2),1e-32)
            a=(1-h*h)*v
            J=np.column_stack(((a[:,:,None]*q[:,None,:]).reshape(len(q),m*12),h,np.ones(len(q))))
            J*=np.sqrt(weights)[:,None]
            G=J.T@J/len(q)
            g=J.T@(np.sqrt(weights)*e)/len(q)
            d=np.maximum(np.diag(G),.000000001)
            accepted=False
            for k in range(6):
                step=np.linalg.solve(G+np.diag(lam*d),-g)
                for frac in [1.,.5,.25,.125,.0625,.03125,.015625,.0078125]:
                    newp=p+frac*step
                    newe=gety(newp,q,m)-yt
                    newloss=np.mean((np.abs(newe)/scale)**power)
                    if newloss<loss:
                        p=newp
                        lam=max(lam*.5,1e-7)
                        accepted=True
                        break
                if accepted: break
                lam*=10
            if not accepted: break
            obj=scale*loss**(1/power)
            if abs(obj-last)<1e-10:
                stagnant+=1
            else: stagnant=0
            last=obj
            if stagnant>=3: break
        ef=gety(p,q,m)-yt
        log.append([int(power),int(t),float(np.sqrt(np.mean(ef**2))),float(np.max(np.abs(ef)))])
    return p,log
